modules.name: The register
modules.responsibility: Hold the register, walk addresses, and perform the verbs — tiers and purge, the journal and rollback, the listener home, the file image and its boot, and construction.

endpoints.name: storeCreate
endpoints.input: &StoreConfig — the closed three-member record: filePath, journalLength, listeners
endpoints.output: Result<Store, StoreError>; every argument validated before any filesystem act

endpoints.name: storeCreateWithConstraints
endpoints.input: &StoreConfig together with &ConstraintsArg — the application's own ordered pair list
endpoints.output: Result<Store, StoreError>; ConstraintListInvalid with no instance when the list is refused

endpoints.name: findAddress / read / readLiteral
endpoints.input: AddressArg and TierArg — readers take absent, one token, or an any-match set
endpoints.output: Result<StoreValue | &NodeRef, StoreError>; a branch refuses readLiteral

endpoints.name: write
endpoints.input: AddressArg, TierArg (exactly one token), StoreValue
endpoints.output: Result<WriteResult, StoreError> — {op, watched, triggered}; no file I/O on any arm

endpoints.name: delete
endpoints.input: AddressArg, TierArg (exactly one token)
endpoints.output: Result<DeleteReceipt, StoreError> — {address, tiers, triggered}; no file I/O at any tier scope

endpoints.name: rollback
endpoints.input: OpIdArg — the op id the caller was given
endpoints.output: Result<RollbackResult, StoreError> — {opId, undoneOps, restoredTo}; all-or-nothing over the subtree

endpoints.name: listen / unlisten / remove_listener
endpoints.input: &ListenerHandle, and for listen the address SET &[Vec<Segment>]
endpoints.output: Result<(), StoreError>; the handle is caller-spelled and never minted

endpoints.name: commit_file
endpoints.input: the op id the settled record carries
endpoints.output: Result<(), StoreError> — the file-tier save, reached as the terminal arm's own act (src/store.rs:1343, inside impl Store)

modules.name: The store's value domain and its JSON image
modules.responsibility: Declare the admitted value taxonomy and convert it to and from the canonical JSON text the file tier stores.

endpoints.name: the admitted value domain (StoreValue)
endpoints.input: a value offered to store-core — str, bool, num, object, array
endpoints.output: the in-domain StoreValue, with every outside class (Null, Undefined, Function, Symbol, BigInt, NonFinite, Cyclic, NonPlainCollection) spellable so its refusal is reachable

endpoints.name: value -> canonical JSON text
endpoints.input: StoreValue
endpoints.output: bytes whose number spelling is the shortest decimal that parses back to the same f64

endpoints.name: JSON text -> value
endpoints.input: the file image's bytes at boot
endpoints.output: StoreValue; any finite JSON number spelling a parser admits is accepted

modules.name: The argument carriers
modules.responsibility: Carry every declared parameter as a permissive Rust type whose outside-value arms make each refusal reachable, and fold it to the in-domain argument or the refusal.

endpoints.name: address_segments
endpoints.input: &AddressArg — List, Absent, Null, Undefined, Str
endpoints.output: Result<Vec<Segment>, StoreError>

endpoints.name: the tier and op-id folds
endpoints.input: &TierArg (Absent / Token / Set / outside arms) and &OpIdArg
endpoints.output: the per-verb arity answer, or the store's own refusal

endpoints.name: the construction folds
endpoints.input: &FilePathArg, &JournalLengthArg, &ListenersArg, &ConstraintsArg
endpoints.output: the closed StoreConfig together with the validated listener and constraint lists, or ConstructionArgumentMissing / ConstraintListInvalid

modules.name: The record shapes
modules.responsibility: Declare the shapes the verbs, the resolver and the listener surface return, including the tier token and the listener identity.

endpoints.name: the verb records
endpoints.input: the settled op, the watched addresses and the triggered pairs
endpoints.output: WriteResult {op, watched, triggered}, DeleteReceipt {address, tiers, triggered}, RollbackResult {opId, undoneOps, restoredTo}

endpoints.name: the journal shapes
endpoints.input: an operation and the compacted base state
endpoints.output: JournalOp and BaseState, as read by a caller and by a boot

endpoints.name: the identity and resolver shapes
endpoints.input: a handle, a binding address, a walked node
endpoints.output: ListenerHandle, Listener, ListenerTrigger {handle, address}, ChildAnchor, NodeRef, and the tier token

modules.name: The closed fail set
modules.responsibility: Hold the sixteen statuses as one closed set and generate every message from the code and the failing trigger's arguments.

endpoints.name: the refusal's construction
endpoints.input: a status plus the MessageArgs of the failing trigger
endpoints.output: StoreError {status, message}, with the message generated and never hand-authored at a call site

endpoints.name: CODES / storeErrorMessage
endpoints.input: nothing, or a status
endpoints.output: the closed sixteen-member set (as a [&'static str; 16]) and the generated message for one member; read by the declaration and by the entry, never minted there

modules.name: The pure-Rust conversion core
modules.responsibility: Model a JS value, admit or refuse it per class, convert in both directions, and hold the per-instance Instance over the store — with no Node-API type at any depth.

endpoints.name: Instance::create / create_with_constraints
endpoints.input: &JsConfig, and for the second &JsConstraintsArg
endpoints.output: Result<Instance, Refusal>

endpoints.name: the verb dispatchers
endpoints.input: the Js* carriers — read, read_literal, write, delete, rollback, listen, unlisten, remove_listener, register, commit_file
endpoints.output: Result<JsValue | JsWriteResult | JsDeleteReceipt | JsRollbackResult, Refusal>

endpoints.name: to_store_value / from_store_value
endpoints.input: &JsValue on the way in; &StoreValue on the way out
endpoints.output: Result<StoreValue, Refusal>, and a JsValue on the way out

endpoints.name: Refusal / registration_refusal
endpoints.input: the failing target, its position and the class that failed
endpoints.output: Refusal {status, message} — the addon's one failure form

modules.name: The wire's codec
modules.responsibility: Convert the Node-API carrier to the core's model and the core's answer back to a Node-API value, over the decided tree.

endpoints.name: the inbound conversions
endpoints.input: a JsVal from a #[napi] parameter — cfg, an address, an address set, a tier, an op id, a handle, a value, a constraint list, a named member
endpoints.output: the core's carrier model (JsConfig, JsAddressArg, JsTierArg, JsValue, …)

endpoints.name: the outbound conversions
endpoints.input: the core's answer — a JsValue, segments, a write result, a delete receipt, a rollback result
endpoints.output: a JsVal the runtime hands the entry (set_member, undefined_value, to_js_value, to_js_segments, to_js_write_result, to_js_delete_receipt, to_js_rollback_result)

modules.name: The Node-API export facade
modules.responsibility: Publish the addon's exported entry functions, each thin over the core, and declare the crate's link and version-stamp treatment.

endpoints.name: storeCreate
endpoints.input: Env and the caller's cfg as a JsVal
endpoints.output: NapiRet — the addon instance, or the store's thrown {status, message}

endpoints.name: the nine verb entries
endpoints.input: the #[napi] parameters of read, readLiteral, write, delete, rollback, listen, unlisten, removeListener, commitFile
endpoints.output: the converted answer as a JsVal, or the refusal

endpoints.name: register
endpoints.input: Env, the store receiver, a handle and a listener slot
endpoints.output: the registration's answer or its refusal

endpoints.name: version / errorMessage
endpoints.input: nothing, or a status with its arguments
endpoints.output: the version string (the build's own stamp) and the generated message

modules.name: The addon's resolution ladder
modules.responsibility: Name the platform packages, read the version stamp, run the three ordered rungs, and answer the one declared absent-addon refusal.

endpoints.name: loadAddon
endpoints.input: the entry's own module context — the platform and arch, and the addon's module-relative path
endpoints.output: the addon namespace from rung one or rung two, or the recorded miss set that becomes the absent-addon refusal

endpoints.name: platformNameFor / platformNameForRuntime
endpoints.input: a platform and an arch
endpoints.output: the scoped platform package name (@auspicion/provident-storeroom-js-…) or null

endpoints.name: packageVersion
endpoints.input: nothing — the entry's own context
endpoints.output: the version string the ladder compares at rung one

modules.name: The entry and its members
modules.responsibility: Publish the module's one export, define the instance's fourteen members, admit each call's arguments at its site, and render the single failure form.

endpoints.name: storeCreate
endpoints.input: cfg — journalLength and listeners required, filePath and constraints optional, a fifth key ignored
endpoints.output: the StoreInstance with fourteen own members, none of them data; or one thrown plain object {status, message[, log]}

endpoints.name: the fourteen members' admission
endpoints.input: the caller's arguments at each member's own positions — address, tier, value, commit, handle, addresses, listener, pair, constraint, opId
endpoints.output: the dispatched store call, or the boundary's refusal carrying a store status that was never minted here

endpoints.name: the failure form
endpoints.input: a status from the store's closed set, the failing subject and its declared position
endpoints.output: the thrown plain object — never an Error subclass, never a rejection, never {ok:false}

modules.name: The JS-side walk
modules.responsibility: Decide each value's class, guard the walk's ceilings and caller-code arms, and encode arguments in and decode answers out.

endpoints.name: encodeValue
endpoints.input: a JS value and its value position (the depth-and-node ceilings are the walk's own)
endpoints.output: the decided tree, or a boundary refusal naming the class that failed and its position

endpoints.name: encodeAddress
endpoints.input: an address argument at its declared position
endpoints.output: the segment list or the refusal — a sparse array, an outside value and a dotted string all refuse

endpoints.name: encodeTier
endpoints.input: a tier argument and the verb's own arity
endpoints.output: the tier carrier — absent, one token, or an any-match set — or the refusal

endpoints.name: encodeConfig / encodeListeners / encodeConstraints
endpoints.input: the construction's cfg and its two optional lists
endpoints.output: the four-key carrier set, or the refusal

endpoints.name: decodeValue / decodeJournalOp
endpoints.input: the addon's answer
endpoints.output: fresh JS data no other side can reach — no proxy, no live view, no getter

modules.name: The registry and the delivery path
modules.responsibility: Hold the package's per-instance state, the handle and its registry, deliver the triggered set to the caller's functions, and perform the terminal arm's file-tier save.

endpoints.name: stateOf / entryOf
endpoints.input: the instance object
endpoints.output: the package's own per-instance state, held behind a weak map and never a member

endpoints.name: registerOn
endpoints.input: a handle and the caller's function
endpoints.output: undefined — one handle one function, a second registration replacing the first

endpoints.name: deliver
endpoints.input: the triggered set the store returned and the triggering address
endpoints.output: void — each registered function invoked with the triggering address as its one argument; an unregistered handle fires nothing silently

endpoints.name: terminalArm
endpoints.input: the record the kernel settled on its passing arm
endpoints.output: the store's commitFile act on a file-tier write's passing arm alone, before any listener body runs

endpoints.name: installAttemptSeam
endpoints.input: the instance at construction
endpoints.output: the attempt accounting the kernel and the entry share under symbol keys

endpoints.name: commitFile / carryRefusal
endpoints.input: an op id, or a call and its arguments
endpoints.output: the addon's commit answer, or the refusal carried unchanged

modules.name: The constraint members and the integrated kernel
modules.responsibility: Carry the five constraint members and the write path's constraint evaluation, and evaluate a write against registered pairs — composing and repairing the attempt and answering its log and report — as one integrated mechanism rather than an external import (strata/decisions.md D-1).

endpoints.name: addConstraint
endpoints.input: a pair {address, id} and the constraint function
endpoints.output: a ConstraintIdentity; an overwrite at a held pair throws nothing for it

endpoints.name: constraintOn / constraintOff
endpoints.input: a pair and the constraint identity
endpoints.output: void — idempotent; a toggle at a pair the store does not carry throws; disabling is not a removal

endpoints.name: removeConstraint
endpoints.input: a pair
endpoints.output: void — the one act that deletes an identity

endpoints.name: constraints
endpoints.input: nothing
endpoints.output: ConstraintPair[] — {address, id} only: no function, no identity, no order, no enabled flag

endpoints.name: constraintWrite
endpoints.input: an address, a tier and a value on the write path
endpoints.output: the evaluated pair set before the durable save, or the refusal

modules.name: The published declaration
modules.responsibility: Declare the whole published surface — the config, the statuses, the records and the fourteen members — as the hand-authored index.d.ts.

endpoints.name: storeCreate / StoreInstance
endpoints.input: the runtime surface the entry publishes
endpoints.output: the declared surface a consumer's type checker reads: one export and fourteen own members

endpoints.name: StoreStatus and the record interfaces
endpoints.input: the store's closed fail set and the record shapes the verbs return
endpoints.output: the sixteen statuses plus the open escape arm (string & {}), and the record, config, pair and identity interfaces

modules.name: What ships and how it is built
modules.responsibility: Own the package manifest, the five per-platform packages, both crate manifests, the shipped README and the release pipeline.

endpoints.name: the package's resolution surface
endpoints.input: a consumer's `import { storeCreate } from 'provident-storeroom'`
endpoints.output: one exports arm — "." to ./index.mjs with ./index.d.ts as its types; no wildcard, no deep import, no CJS arm

endpoints.name: the files allowlist
endpoints.input: the shipped set the manifest names
endpoints.output: exactly four entries: index.mjs, README.md, index.d.ts, src/constraint-kernel.mjs; no LICENSE row, no build path, no .node entry

endpoints.name: the release pipeline
endpoints.input: a workflow run at the pinned version
endpoints.output: provident-storeroom@0.5.0 plus the five @auspicion platform packages, each pinned exactly at 0.5.0 as an optionalDependency

modules.name: The store-side battery
modules.responsibility: Drive the native crate's declared behaviour through its own integration battery.

endpoints.name: cargo test (the store crate)
endpoints.input: the crate at src/, built in its declared offline form
endpoints.output: a per-file pass/red row set over construction, the walk, the arms, the tiers, the journal, the listener firing and the fail codes — the store's own measured green

modules.name: The binding crate's battery
modules.responsibility: Drive the conversion core's per-class table in Rust, with no Node runtime present.

endpoints.name: cargo test --manifest-path bindings/js/Cargo.toml
endpoints.input: the binding crate's rlib half
endpoints.output: the crossing's per-class rows, the copy discipline and the registration layer, measured without a Node runtime

modules.name: The JS battery
modules.responsibility: Drive the assembled package through the entry: surface, kernel, listeners, codec, properties, publication.

endpoints.name: node --test bindings/js/test/*.test.mjs
endpoints.input: the assembled package, reached as a consumer reaches it (import { storeCreate } from 'provident-storeroom'), and the kernel at its checkout home
endpoints.output: a per-file pass/red row set over the surface, the kernel, the held listener identity, the JSON crossing, the file-tier save, the publication and the version stamp

modules.name: The greens runners
modules.responsibility: Drive the assembled package as a caller from outside, per wave, and report each green with its layer.

endpoints.name: npm run greens
endpoints.input: the built artefact and the entry, in a real Node process, at a real caller-spelled filePath
endpoints.output: greens.mjs, live-drive.mjs and file-tier-save/scenarios.mjs each reporting their cells with the LAYER label

endpoints.name: the per-wave live drivers
endpoints.input: the blind sets authored from the documentation alone
endpoints.output: cell-by-cell observations for the constraints, the held listener identity, the JSON crossing and the JSON acceptance set, each read as a finding and never as a pass
